Measurement Pipeline

  • Zero AI / No HRNet: Pure WebXR geometric metric tracking.
  • Automatic Surface Detection: Continuous multi-ray hit-testing probes visible flat surfaces without manual point tapping.
  • Farthest Two Points: Real-time 3D Euclidean distance maximization over detected coplanar surface points.
  • Synchronized Capture: Freezes 3D metric coordinates and exact 2D camera pixel projections simultaneously at the click instant.

Requires Android Chrome 81+ with Google Play Services for AR (ARCore), or WebXR emulator.
